name: smuggle
description: The raw-drug supply loop (Phase 2). Place black-market raw orders **through a fence NPC's dialogue** (Sully at the Pigeon Bar, unlocked by reaching the covert dealer's inner circle); a MULE drone drops a cipher-locked crate at a far lawless airstrip (the Scald); `unpack` it there to claim the raw and build standing with the fence (which widens his order menu), then smuggle the raw back past a scanner checkpoint into the city (Deception check scaled to cook_tier; fail = Manufacturing WANTED_RAISE + bounce + 45s heat). Registers the PLACE_SMUGGLE_ORDER dialogue action.
